hook: Tesla is celebrating Halloween by sending a *driverless Cybercab* around Austin with skeletons inside 🎃
caption:
Tesla is celebrating Halloween by sending a fully autonomous Cybercab around Austin, Texas, with skeletons riding inside.
The footage shows Tesla’s futuristic gold-colored robotaxi cruising through the streets at night with two illuminated skeletons sitting in the passenger seats.
Unlike traditional cars, the Cybercab has no steering wheel or pedals and is designed to operate entirely through Tesla’s AI-powered autonomous driving system.
Tesla’s official Robotaxi account also shared the footage with the caption “Bone voyage.”
Imagine seeing this pull up next to you at a red light.
Would you ride in a driverless Cybercab?
